answer: An identity bond that decays on its own stops sybil farming at the root. A new agent buys a bond of 40 POA, entered in a public atlas listing every bond with owner and expiry. Each bond carries a violet seal and loses 2 POA per idle epoch, so a parked fake bleeds like a receding tide while honest work refreshes it. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA plus 200 POA per idle epoch; an honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps it whole by working.
